title: Global ringed-space tensor comparison polygon
statement: For p:(X,O_X)→(pt,Γ(X,O_X)), use the global pullback P, left-derived L, comparison α and natural bifunctorial tensor isomorphism δ of lem-sc-module-cup-global-tensor-pullback. Equivalently any such P,L,α,δ with the displayed K-flat normalization satisfy the following. For all homotopy complexes K,M of Γ(X,O_X)-modules, L.map(μ_Qh(K,M)) followed by α_{K tensor M} followed by Qh of the totalized ordinary inverse tensor constraint equals δ_{QhK,QhM} followed by α_K tensor^L α_M followed by μ_Qh(PK,PM). This is exactly the full six-vertex polygon of Tag 0FP0, with its two left downward arrows composed. K and M are arbitrary integer complexes, not required to be K-flat or bounded, and X is unrestricted. Naturality of δ and its K-flat normalization are explicit hypotheses fixing the same canonical tensor isomorphism as the first node.

proof.text: Choose K-flat resolutions K0→K and M0→M. Their total tensor is K-flat. Naturality of the ordinary inverse tensor constraint gives the rectangle after applying P. Naturality of α and of the lax tensor comparison of Qh identifies the right path with the normalized K0,M0 path followed by the tensor of the resolution maps. Naturality of δ identifies the corresponding left path. The K-flat normalization in lem-sc-module-cup-global-tensor-pullback makes these paths equal on K0,M0. Qh sends both resolution maps to isomorphisms; L and derived tensor preserve them. Cancel their tensor composite to obtain the displayed equality for K,M. Every object in the homotopy category has a complex representative, so the proof covers the formal statement.

theorem globalRingedSpace_tensor_comparison_diagram
    (P : ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    [P.Additive] [P.Monoidal] [P.IsLeftAdjoint]
    (L : DerivedCategory
        (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)))
    (α : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
      P.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (δ : ∀ A B, L.obj (A ⊗ B) ≅ L.obj A ⊗ L.obj B)
    (hnat : ∀ A A' B B' (f : A ⟶ A') (g : B ⟶ B'),
      L.map (f ⊗ₘ g) ≫ (δ A' B').hom = (δ A B).hom ≫ (L.map f ⊗ₘ L.map g))
    (hflat : ∀ K M : CochainComplex
        (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))) ℤ,
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).kFlat K →
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).kFlat M →
        moduleCup_globalTensorDiagram X P L α δ
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj K)
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj M))
    (K M : HomotopyCategory
      (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) :
    moduleCup_globalTensorDiagram X P L α δ K M
